metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2023 · Past Lives
metas.description: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Twenty years later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront notions of love and destiny.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · Poor Things
metas.description: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2024 · Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of Russian oligarchs, but her fairy tale is threatened when his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · The Invite
metas.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Downton Abbey: A New Era
metas.description: The Crawleys go on a grand journey to the south of France to uncover the mystery of the Dowager Countess' newly inherited villa.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · Where the Crawdads Sing
metas.description: A woman who raised herself in the marshes of the Deep South becomes a suspect in the murder of a man with whom she was once involved.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · The Drama
metas.description: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Challengers
metas.description: Tashi, a former tennis prodigy turned coach, transformed her husband into a champion. But to overcome a recent losing streak and redeem himself, he'll need to face off against his former best friend and Tashi's ex-boyfriend.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · Red, White & Royal Blue
metas.description: When the feud between the son of the American President and Britain's prince threatens to drive a wedge in U.S./British relations, the two are forced into a staged truce that sparks something deeper.
